title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29
lineage: Transfer: Cassette > Tascam 122 MK3 > Korg MR2000S > DFF @5.6 MHz > Audiogate > wav 24/96. Lineage: wav 24/96 > iZotope RX8 Advanced
taper: This is Mark Cohen’s tape (Judy Lee’s brother) who worked for Electra records. It was given to Mark by Hail Milgraham, who was a colleague at Electra.

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 60s performance captured in a pleasant recording that fans describe as audio history at its finest
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the band's tight playing and the vibrant energy of this mid‑60s show, calling it “on point” and “audio history.” While no technical details are given, the consensus is that the recording sounds good enough to enjoy the vintage vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (5, 5, 4 stars) and praise both performance and overall sound, indicating a high‑quality show with an adequately clear recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as “audio history at its finest” and express no complaints about clarity or mix, implying a satisfactory listening experience.
